newsitem.title: USA: Consumat new sales plans to hurt results.
newsitem.headline: Consumat new sales plans to hurt results.

text.p: Consumat Environmental Systems Inc said on Thursday it began a concentrated sales and marketing effort in the second half of 1996, but related costs would hurt its 1996 and 1997 results.

Since the program began, Consumat said it signed new sales agreements with representatives in Pennsylvania, Taiwan and Turkey. It also hoped to establish a sales presence in South Korea, Thailand and parts of the United States soon, it said.
Consumat designs and makes capital equipment for the medical, industrial and municipal solid waste industries.
The company said it would establish sales representation in Latin America in the second half of 1997.
